name: Staff of Toxins
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 202, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 298
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 202, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 298
Aura moderate varies CL 9th
Slot none; Price 34,200 gp; Weight 5 lbs.
Description
This length of hemlock-shrouded oak gives off the faintest whiff of rot and corruption. It allows use of the following spells:
Stinking cloud (1 charge)
Cloudkill (2 charges)
Construction
Requirements Craft Staff, cloudkill, stinking cloud; Cost 17,100 gp
